name: When should I call a professional plumber for a clogged drain instead of using DIY methods?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional plumber for a clogged drain instead of using DIY methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber for a clogged drain if common DIY methods like plungers or store-bought drain cleaners don't resolve the issue, or if the clog recurs frequently. Persistent clogs, especially those affecting multiple fixtures, can indicate a deeper problem within your plumbing system, such as a main line obstruction. A professional can accurately diagnose the cause using specialized tools and ensure the clog is completely cleared without damaging your pipes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if DIY methods fail, clogs are frequent, or multiple fixtures are affected, as this may indicate a main line issue.
